name: Eiddilig Gor

attributes.attribute: a dwarf and one of the Three Enchanters of Britain
could take the form of any creature of earth, air, or water

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Eiddilig Gor is a British figure. He numbers among the Three Enchanters of Britain. A dwarf, he can flee any hunter. He shifts his form into any being of the land, sea, or air.

okr.objective: Set out the British dwarf Eiddilig Gor, a master of change among the Three Enchanters.
key_results: He counts among Britannia's Enchanters, a famous trio of Britain.
He can take the form of any being of the land, sea, or air.
This power lets him escape any pursuer.
